title: SharkMQP26
summary: A research project (Worcester Polytechnic Institute Major Qualifying Project) analyzing shark-related data, with a dedicated script for generating synthetic tabular data. SyntheticDataVaultGen.py imports SDV's single-table module and metadata schema, fitting a GaussianCopulaSynthesizer on the project's data to produce synthetic samples.
